'''Di Blinths''' was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]. It was home to [[X'Ting]], including [[Jesson Di Blinth]].
